d.d: A member of a Turkic people living primarily in Kyrgyzstan.
Of, from, or relating to Kyrgyzstan, the Kyrgyz people, or the Kyrgyz language
The Turkic language of the Kyrgyz people
A country in Central Asia, bordering on Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan and China. Official name: Kyrgyz Republic. Capital: Bishkek.
A short prayer or petition including the phrase kyrie eleison, meaning “Lord, have mercy”.
A setting of the traditional kyrie text to music for a Mass.
